henry.title: Twinkle on Piano, Then the F Chord
henry.intro: The star tune for this Moon week. Piano first, then ukulele chord F. About 15 minutes. The cello is broken — leave it in the case. A guitar pluck is only the challenge.
steps: 🎵 Listen to the first minute, or hum Twinkle if the video will not play.
🎹 Play line 1 on the piano: C C G G A A G, then F F E E D D C.
🎸 Learn F on the ukulele: two fingers, like the picture.
🔁 Strum C, F, C while you sing “Twinkle, twinkle, little star.”
✏️ Fill in the worksheet.
links: First minute only. Hear the plain tune, then faster notes. Humming counts if the video fails.

passage.text: ⭐ Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star uses an old French tune. The words come from Jane Taylor’s poem, 1806.
passage.q: Which country is the tune from?

passage.text: 🎹 Mozart wrote 12 variations. A variation is the same tune, changed — faster, fancier, or softer.
🔤 The ABC song uses this tune. So does Baa, Baa, Black Sheep. On the ukulele, “little” in line 1 takes the F chord.

handsOn.title: Piano line, then F on the ukulele
steps: guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Find C: the white key just left of the two black keys.
guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Play C C G G A A G. Then F F E E D D C. That is line 1.
guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Make one small change: play it softer, or a little faster.
guides/uke-f-chord.svg
Ukulele F: pointer on the E string, fret 1. Middle finger on the G string, fret 2.
guides/uke-c-chord.svg
Switch C for 4 strums, then F for 4 strums. Count the switches.
guides/uke-f-chord.svg
Sing: “Twinkle, twinkle” on C, “little” on F, “star” on C.
handsOn.look: F needs two fingertips. Thumb stays behind the neck. The cello stays in the case.
handsOn.q: Questions 5 to 7 come from the piano and the ukulele.

worksheet: The Twinkle tune is a ______ song. Circle: French / Japanese
A variation is: Circle: the same tune, changed / a brand new song
Same tune: Circle: ABC song / Happy Birthday
Piano: C C G G A A ___. Circle: G / F
For F: pointer on the ____ string, middle on the ____ string.
I switched C to F ____ times. The cello was not used. Circle: true
henry.challenge: Play your softer or faster variation for someone and let them guess the song. If a guitar is out, pluck one open string and say if it sounds lower than the ukulele. Then go back to the ukulele. Do not use the cello.

parentKey.assess: Score the worksheet and whether he played the piano line and switched C and F. 5 = tune and chord attempted, and the circled facts are right. The guitar pluck and the variation performance are the challenge, not required. There is no Regolith today.

items.a: French. 12. The same tune, changed. ABC song. The next piano note is G (C C G G A A G).
Pointer on the E string, fret 1. Middle finger on the G string, fret 2. Switch count is whatever he actually counted. Cello unused: true.

frankie.title: Twinkle Dots and Seven Stars ⭐🎹
frankie.intro: Grown-up, read aloud. We play a star song and put out 7 star stickers. About 14 minutes. No cello. No drawing with a pencil — stickers or coins are the stars.
steps: 🏷️ Find the new purple 6, after red 5.
🎶 Play the number tune with a grown-up.
⭐ Put 7 stickers, coins, or LEGO like the Big Dipper.
🔤 Sound out dot. Trace, then write it.

handsOn.title: Twinkle numbers and the Big Dipper
steps: guides/piano-c-to-a.svg
Grown-up: if you use stickers, purple 6 is the white key just after red 5. C is key 1.
guides/twinkle-numbers.svg
Press 1 1 5 5 6 6 5, then 4 4 3 3 2 2 1. Sing along. Humming counts.
guides/big-dipper.svg
Put 7 stars on dark paper, or use 7 coins or LEGO bricks. 3 in the handle, 4 in the cup.
guides/big-dipper.svg
Count them out loud together.
handsOn.look: The jump from 1 up to 5 is the hard part. Point at red 5 before he plays it.

worksheet:
Which key is new? Circle the purple 6.
1   2   3   4   5   6

Count the Big Dipper stars. Circle the number.
⭐⭐⭐ + ⭐⭐⭐⭐ = 6   7   8

Sound it out. Draw a line.
dot   pig   cup
🐷   ☕   🔵
Circle every is: It is a star. It is big.

parentKey.assess: Score the playing and the sheet. Purple 6, 7 stars, word match, both is words, the star picture. Writing dot is the stretch. No Regolith and no cello.

items.a: Circle 6. Big Dipper has 7 stars (3 in the handle, 4 in the cup).
dot → 🔵, pig → 🐷, cup → ☕. Circle both is. Circle ⭐. Stretch: dot.
